lines.criterion: Compares all three approaches with specific trade-offs.
Makes a single expand-contract recommendation justified by constraints.
Preserves old readers for seven days, dual-writes and retains original ambiguous names.
Uses batched resumable backfill and verifies row counts/name preservation before switching.
Keeps old columns and offers a read-path rollback within 10 minutes; no early destructive drop.
Explicitly honors <=60-second downtime, one operator and no paid new infrastructure.
